# Google AI for Developers

> > Official documentation and resources for the Gemini API, Google's multimodal AI platform for developers.

This site provides comprehensive guides, API references, and SDKs for integrating Gemini AI capabilities into applications across Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, Java, C#, and Apps Script. It covers everything from quickstart tutorials to billing configuration and rate limit management.

## Key Topics

- Gemini API
- Google GenAI SDK
- Python SDK
- JavaScript SDK
- TypeScript
- API authentication
- Rate limits and quotas
- Billing and pricing tiers
- API versions (v1 vs v1beta)
- Multi-language support
- RPM/TPM/RPD limits
- Cloud Billing integration
- API key management
- SDK installation (pip, npm, Maven)

## Getting Started

- [Gemini API quickstart](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/quickstart): Gemini API quickstart guide with Python & JavaScript SDK setup

## API Configuration & Management

- [API versions explained](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/api-versions): Gemini API version differences: v1 stable vs v1beta features
- [Rate limits](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/rate-limits): Gemini API rate limits, quotas (RPM/TPM/RPD), and usage tiers
- [Billing](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/billing): Gemini API billing setup, pricing tiers, and Cloud Billing config
